senses.definition: (A girl or woman who embraces) a trend or subculture of the late 2010s and early 2020s, characterized by heavy use of social media and relaxed, beachy fashion.
senses.example: The VSCO girl not only looks bright and beach-ready — she also radiates with a desire to “save the turtles.”
